name: mureka-api
description: Runnable Node.js and Python examples for the Mureka API by useapi.net — a Suno / Udio alternative. Full songs from your lyrics or a description with Mureka V9.5, V9, V8 and O2, your own voice as the singer on Mureka Premier, instrumentals, sheet music (MusicXML and PDF from a song, YouTube link or MP3), extend, and multi-speaker speech.
author: useapi.net
